ambient.intent: Non-combat presence — no hunt, no attacks.

chase.intent: Close and pursue living targets. Monster prey is other-faction only.

demolish.intent: Building-first chew; also hunts other-faction creatures when AI is wired.

grow.intent: Grown-giant path — debris scrape vs buildings and player pressure.

guard.intent: Hold a post; engage the player and other-faction monsters.

skirmish.intent: Standoff / ranged pressure — hunt player, peds, and other-faction monsters; no structure chew. Attack pool is the full caster/artillery set; AI selection among them is deferred.

wander_hunt.intent: Roam and hunt living targets like chase — other-faction monsters included.
